title: Deeper/broader DWG reader release-boundary and 3D evidence-source audit
mode: primary-source web research and read-only local plan review
scope: Reconcile the current ezdwg published artifact with its mutable development source and documented entity/version paths
Recheck whether its reader, DXF writer, and native DWG writer are independent evidence routes
Verify the official OCCT licensing and kernel-lineage boundary for ACIS SAT/SAB evidence
Update optional peer admission while preserving focused validation and deferred external support conditions

method.kind: Read primary project, package-index, and official OCCT source pages; compare with existing local route plan
method.limitations: GitHub main documentation is mutable. PyPI reports that ezdwg 0.16.3 was not uploaded using Trusted Publishing; the current GitHub workspace version matches the release string, but this review did not establish a cryptographic source-commit-to-sdist/wheel relationship or conduct a full parser provenance audit. No executable, local sample, CAD kernel, or native consumer was tested.

sources.revision: Published release page reviewed 2026-10-18; release date shown as 2026-10-17
sources.observed: The latest published version is 0.16.3. The source distribution SHA-256 is 77978afa63fdcc61a18abbd581b9bb1cdac09e5a1747840bb689fbd9771b230c. PyPI metadata says Trusted Publishing was not used. Platform wheels exist and must be treated as separate artifacts with their own hashes.

sources.project: ezdwg README, current workspace/core manifests, and API documentation
sources.revision: Mutable GitHub main reviewed 2026-10-18; current workspace version reads 0.16.3
sources.observed: The Rust core exposes raw decode functions and a high-level document/layout/entity API. Its direct manifest dependency is encoding_rs. The README states AC1012/AC1014 are experimental, names a narrow native-decode regression subset for modern AC codes, reports best-effort style/layer-color behavior on some files, limits the native writer to AC1015/subsets, and identifies ezdxf as the DWG-to-DXF writer backend. The version-string match does not bind source to PyPI artifact.

sources.revision: Mutable main reviewed 2026-10-18; changes are under the Unreleased heading
sources.observed: Unreleased notes describe additional native AC1021/AC1024/AC1027 decode paths, removal of a DWG compatibility-conversion route, additional version-aware fields/dimensions, and paired-DXF tests. These source-tree notes are not attributed to the 0.16.3 release absent an immutable matching artifact. Paired DXF checks are not by themselves native DWG producer truth.

sources.project: Official OCCT components and distribution documentation
sources.observed: Official sources classify ACIS SAT/SAB exchange as a commercial OCCT component outside the open-source core. This establishes a licensing boundary, not local entitlement, exact-profile behavior, independent-kernel status, or DWG/AcDs container support.

sources.project: Existing libdxfrw implementation and 3D route plans
sources.revision: Working tree over baseline de27a3391a624aba03ca71f3583c4b3a6e6396a9 reviewed 2026-10-18
sources.observed: Existing gates already separate 2D reader comparison, writer output, ACIS/AcDs association, geometry-kernel results, native application acceptance, and external J criteria. The update refines release/kernel lineage only and preserves optional composed-checkpoint execution.

assessment.planImpact: Clarifies that ezdwg 0.16.3 remains an optional candidate only for exact documented common-2D reader comparisons; its release artifact is distinct from mutable Unreleased main and its writers are separate routes. Confirms that OCCT ACIS SAT/SAB exchange is a commercial extension and, if licensed, remains OCCT-kernel-correlated and outside the outer DWG/AcDs join. No required implementation action, dependency, or gate was added.

implementationReadyChecks: Do not use ezdwg development-branch claims as evidence for the 0.16.3 PyPI artifact unless an immutable source/artifact link is established.
At the existing optional composed checkpoint, pin either the exact sdist plus build inputs or one exact platform wheel; keep those routes distinct.
Compare only exact AC-code/entity/field cases and report inferred or unsupported graph fields as unavailable, not empty or matching.
Keep ezdwg parsing, its ezdxf-backed DXF output, and its subset AC1015 DWG output as separate evidence rows.
Do not treat 3DFACE, 3D polylines, or mesh entities as 3DSOLID/REGION ACIS semantics.
Do not treat open-source OCCT core as an ACIS reader; any already-licensed OCCT ACIS component is optional, shares OCCT kernel lineage with FreeCAD, and cannot prove DWG/AcDs association.
Do not add peer setup, full-suite runs, dependencies, or external samples to the per-slice implementation loop.
Keep findings/subplans at 130/73 and J256, J260, J268, J284, J293, and J295 DEFERRED_EXTERNAL.
